headline.en: See when recorded test progress levels off.
headline.zh: 看清记录的测试进展何时停滞。

sub.en: MargLedger pairs recorded iteration costs with test-pass deltas and produces a post-hoc stop recommendation from an explicit flat-progress rule.
sub.zh: MargLedger 将记录的迭代成本与通过测试数变化配对，按明确停滞规则生成事后停止建议。

body.en: Each row keeps test delta and token cost together.
body.zh: 每行同时保留测试变化与 token 成本。

body.en: Epsilon and consecutive-iteration count are inspectable.
body.zh: 阈值与连续轮数可检查。

body.en: Sparse or unverified fields stay labeled.
body.zh: 稀疏或未验证字段保留标记。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: Four synthetic iterations declare pass counts 1, 3, 3, 3 and a cost of 1100 tokens each. The example builds the ledger and applies K=2.
note.zh: 四轮合成输入声明通过数 1、3、3、3，每轮 1100 token。示例生成账本并应用 K=2。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: Four explicit synthetic iterations with known test-pass counts and token costs produce a post-hoc stop recommendation; no agent is stopped or measured savings achieved.
steps.output:
{
  "marginal_values": [
    1.0,
    2.0,
    0.0,
    0.0
  ],
  "cumulative_tokens": 4400,
  "recommendation": {
    "stop": true,
    "knee_iter": 3,
    "stop_iter": 3,
    "reason": "marginal_value <= 0 for 2 consecutive iters from iter 3",
    "tokens_saved": 1100,
    "hard_budget_iters": null,
    "consecutive_flat": 2,
    "epsilon": 0,
    "k": 2
  }
}

body.en: Four synthetic iterations declare pass counts 1, 3, 3, 3 and a cost of 1100 tokens each. The example builds the ledger and applies K=2.
body.zh: 四轮合成输入声明通过数 1、3、3、3，每轮 1100 token。示例生成账本并应用 K=2。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/margledger.git
cd margledger
uv venv .venv
uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e .
source .venv/bin/activate

limitations.en: The tool analyzes finished data and does not stop an agent automatically.
limitations.zh: 工具分析已完成数据，不会自动停止 Agent。

limitations.en: Passing-test count is a limited signal; changed or flaky tests can alter it without improving the software. Missing inline test snapshots currently contribute zero recorded gain.
limitations.zh: 通过测试数量是有限信号；修改或不稳定测试可能改变数量而未改进软件。缺少轮内测试快照时当前实现记为零已记录增益。

limitations.en: The reported knee is retrospective and requires later observations. tokens_saved is a counterfactual label over recorded spend, not achieved savings.
limitations.zh: 拐点是依赖后续观察的事后结果；tokens_saved 是对已记录消费的反事实标签，不是已实现节省。

body.en: A fixed budget says how much a loop may spend, but it does not show whether observed test progress continues. A ledger makes each iteration’s recorded gain and cost inspectable.
body.zh: 固定预算只说明循环最多可花多少，不能展示测试进展是否继续。账本让每轮已记录增益与成本可检查。

body.en: Source adapters produce RawIteration records. build_ledger computes passing-test deltas and cumulative token cost; an optional final JUnit snapshot reconciles the last value. recommend searches for K consecutive marginal values at or below epsilon and reports the start of that retrospective run.
body.zh: 来源适配器生成 RawIteration；build_ledger 计算通过测试数差值和累计 token，可用最终 JUnit 快照对齐最后一轮价值。recommend 查找连续 K 轮不高于 epsilon 的边际值，报告该事后停滞段起点。

body.en: Source adapters produce RawIteration records. build_ledger computes passing-test deltas and cumulative token cost; an optional final JUnit snapshot reconciles the last value. recommend searches for K consecutive marginal values at or below epsilon and reports the start of that retrospective run.
body.zh: 来源适配器生成 RawIteration；build_ledger 计算通过测试数差值和累计 token，可用最终 JUnit 快照对齐最后一轮价值。recommend 查找连续 K 轮不高于 epsilon 的边际值，报告该事后停滞段起点。

body.en: The following routes are implemented in the source. Choose the input that matches your task and keep the resulting artifact with your project.
body.zh: 以下路径已有源码实现。按任务选择输入，并把生成的结果与项目一起保存。

body.en: --epsilon and --k control the flat-progress rule; --hard-budget is an iteration-count comparison frame. --source selects auto, claude_code, generic or cursor. Cursor-derived fields can be sparse or schema_unverified and must retain those qualifications.
body.zh: --epsilon 与 --k 控制停滞规则；--hard-budget 是迭代数比较背景。--source 可选 auto、claude_code、generic 或 cursor；Cursor 字段可能标记 sparse 或 schema_unverified，需要保留这些限定。

body.en: The CLI exposes the following operations. Commands after the example use your own paths or identifiers.
body.zh: CLI 提供以下操作。示例之外的命令需要替换成你的文件路径或标识。

details.code:
margledger trace tests/fixtures/sample_transcript.jsonl --tests tests/fixtures/sample_junit.xml -o ledger.json
margledger recommend ledger.json --epsilon 0 --k 2 --json
margledger replay ledger.json --markdown -o report.md
